hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Southeastern Asia, along the northern coast of the island of Borneo, bordering the South China Sea and Malaysia || flat coastal plain rises to mountains in east; hilly lowland in west || close to vital sea lanes through South China Sea linking Indian and Pacific Oceans; two parts physically separated by Malaysia; the eastern part, the Temburong district, is an exclave and is almost an enclave within Malaysia || Resources: petroleum, natural gas, timber || Exports: refined petroleum, natural gas, crude petroleum, hydrocarbons, fertilizers (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: flat coastal plain rises to mountains in east; hilly lowland in west || Southeastern Asia, along the northern coast of the island of Borneo, bordering the South China Sea and Malaysia

climate.excerpt: tropical; hot, humid, rainy || typhoons, earthquakes, and severe flooding are rare

economy.excerpt: almost exclusively an oil and gas economy; high income country; expansive and robust welfare system; the majority of the population works for the government; promulgating a nationalized halal brand; considering establishment of a bond market and stock exchange || Exports: refined petroleum, natural gas, crude petroleum, hydrocarbons, fertilizers (2023) || Industries: petroleum, petroleum refining, liquefied natural gas, construction, agriculture, aquaculture, transportation
